claim_boundary: Paired differences of MaBoSS phase-averaged and final-tick node occupancies between model versions on common random numbers, at each phase's declared dimensionless horizon. The interval is the run-to-run reproducibility of the paired estimator on disjoint seed blocks: not an i.i.d. Monte Carlo SE, not a biological, experimental or kinetic uncertainty, and no statement about days. WITHIN_TOLERANCE means no detected transient change at this precision, never no change.

c1only_vs_v051.rule: addendum 01 A1: final-tick per-state distributions bitwise equal AND every per-tick node difference <= 1e-12, in every replicate at every trajectory count run

c5only_vs_v051.rule: addendum 01 A1: final-tick per-state distributions bitwise equal AND every per-tick node difference <= 1e-12, in every replicate at every trajectory count run

families.interpretation: Families per comparison are derived from that comparison's own rules: primary = the changed node(s), downstream = their transitive readers, unaffected = every other node. For v052_vs_v051 this is exactly the pre-registered 2 + 5 + 52 split; for the attribution arms it is the reading of section 3's 'defined the same way' as the same derivation.

horizon: declared relative_duration per phase (dimensionless MaBoSS time)
